description: Wallet Counterparties. Calls only GET /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/counterparties and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching wallet counterparties. Analyze transfer relationships, volumes and interactions with wallets or programs over time.

group.description: Enumeration of supported counterparty grouping values used by this API model.

limit.description: Maximum number of counterparties to return. Defaults to 1000.

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/wallets/{ownerAddress}/counterparties.

page.description: Page number to return (zero-indexed). Defaults to 0.

sortByAsc.description: Sort ascending by 'totalTransfers', 'totalVolume', 'netVolume', 'sellTransfers', 'buyTransfers', 'sellVolume', or 'buyVolume'. If omitted, no sorting is applied. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used.

sortByDesc.description: Sort descending by 'totalTransfers', 'totalVolume', 'netVolume', 'sellTransfers', 'buyTransfers', 'sellVolume', or 'buyVolume'. If omitted, no sorting is applied. Only one of `sortByAsc` or `sortByDesc` can be used.

timeEnd.description: End of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Defaults to the current time.

timeStart.description: Start of the time range (unix timestamp, seconds). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

name: get-wallet-counterparties
title: Wallet Counterparties
